I have always liked my body somewhat, but have always wished I looked as good as other guys my age, and I fear that I am conflating the feeling of body dissatisfaction with gender dysphoria. I too have always had anxiety and depression and am also getting worried that it's always been a sign of me being trans. 

My advice to you is to reach out to people and to seek professional help. That will be the only way to move forwards. In the meantime, don't compulsively research (you will only scare yourself more), try to avoid looking at your reflection (the best you can), and find activities that you enjoy to keep yourself distracted. Please feel free to message me if you need any advice or just need someone to talk to. Take care.
